blocks.features: Excerpt from e.e. cummings's "she being Brand", with unusual embedded punctuation inside single run-together words (e.g. 'tremB\n-ling', 'a:dead.', ';Still)'), attributed at the end.

blocks.text: from she being Brand, by e. e. cummings
